caption: The timeline at a desk: each clip's glyph, length and bar in its kind's own hue.
The timeline in ink only: the glyph alone names each kind, the bars one neutral fill.
The reason line's controls open inside its own row, across the timeline, its spring marked ad hoc.
The reason line's controls in an inspector beside the timeline, headed by the clip's line.
Pointing at the panel's leading edge: the corner arc runs up it past the pointer, thickened in the strong ink.
The phone's timeline: each clip's glyph, length and bar in its kind's own hue.
The phone's timeline in ink only: the glyph alone names each kind, the bars one neutral fill.
The reason line's controls open inside its own row, under its facts; the timeline scrolls on past them.
On a phone the inspector takes the timeline's place, Back leading its head.
On a phone the panel is the drawer: its grabber on the top edge resizes it, and the arc has no corner to stand in.
